msg: There appears to be two groups of gnomes. One group gives a red basket and the other a yellow basket. The red gnomes have the red baskets and the other coloured gnomes have the yellow basket.At the start of the game try to identify which gnomes correspond to which group, then aim to pick the group that gives the highest pay off.  The highest I have seen is +10. When the payoff from that group shrinks toward zero, switch groups and you’ll probably find that the group you just switched to is giving the higher payoff. Use your intuition to switch between groups during the game to achieve the highest payoff and try to track which gnomes you should switch out.
